logger.doc:name: Log Validating Record
logger.message: #["[DEBUG] Validating billing record | RecordId: " ++ (payload.id as String default "unknown")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var record = payload var validationErrors = [] ++ (if (record.customer_id == null) ["customer_id is required"] else []) ++ (if (record.account_number == null) ["account_number is required"] else []) ++ (if (record.usage_amount == null or record.usage_amount < 0) ["usage_amount must be a positive number"] else []) ++ (if (record.billing_period_start == null) ["billing_period_start is required"] else []) ++ (if (record.billing_period_end == null) ["billing_period_end is required"] else []) --- { record: record, isValid: isEmpty(validationErrors), validationErrors: validationErrors }

logger.doc:name: Log Transforming Record
logger.message: #["[DEBUG] Transforming billing record | RecordId: " ++ (payload.id as String default "unknown")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { id: payload.id, customerId: payload.customer_id, accountNumber: payload.account_number, billingPeriodStart: payload.billing_period_start, billingPeriodEnd: payload.billing_period_end, usageAmount: payload.usage_amount as Number, ratePlanId: payload.rate_plan_id, status: "PROCESSING", originalStatus: payload.status, createdAt: payload.created_at, updatedAt: payload.updated_at, processedAt: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Calculating Billing
logger.message: #["[DEBUG] Calculating billing amounts | RecordId: " ++ (payload.id as String default "unknown")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var baseRate = 0.10 var taxRate = 0.08 var usageAmount = payload.usageAmount as Number default 0 var subtotal = usageAmount * baseRate var taxAmount = subtotal * taxRate var totalAmount = subtotal + taxAmount --- payload ++ { baseRate: baseRate, subtotal: subtotal, taxRate: taxRate, taxAmount: taxAmount, totalAmount: totalAmount, currency: "USD", calculatedAt: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Validating Customer
logger.message: #["[DEBUG] Validating customer for invoice | CustomerId: " ++ (payload.customer_id as String default "unknown")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var record = payload var validationErrors = [] ++ (if (record.customer_id == null) ["customer_id is required"] else []) ++ (if (record.customer_name == null or isEmpty(record.customer_name)) ["customer_name is required"] else []) ++ (if (record.customer_email == null or isEmpty(record.customer_email)) ["customer_email is required"] else []) ++ (if (record.billing_address == null) ["billing_address is required"] else []) ++ (if (record.total_amount == null or record.total_amount <= 0) ["total_amount must be positive"] else []) --- { record: record, isValid: isEmpty(validationErrors), validationErrors: validationErrors }

logger.doc:name: Log Generating Invoice
logger.message: #["[DEBUG] Generating invoice | CustomerId: " ++ (payload.customer_id as String default "unknown")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var invoiceNumber = "INV-" ++ (now() as String {format: "yyyyMMdd"}) ++ "-" ++ (uuid() splitBy("-"))[0] --- { invoiceNumber: invoiceNumber, customerId: payload.customer_id, customerName: payload.customer_name, customerEmail: payload.customer_email, billingAddress: payload.billing_address, taxId: payload.tax_id, billingId: payload.billing_id, billingPeriodStart: payload.billing_period_start, billingPeriodEnd: payload.billing_period_end, subtotal: payload.total_amount, taxAmount: payload.tax_amount, invoiceDate: now(), dueDate: now() + |P30D|, status: "GENERATED", createdAt: now() }

%dw 2.0 output application/java var subtotal = payload.subtotal as Number default 0 var taxAmount = payload.taxAmount as Number default 0 var totalAmount = subtotal + taxAmount --- payload ++ { totalAmount: totalAmount, currency: "USD", calculatedAt: now() }
